requirements.summary: Check the numerical plan scale in the title block

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Confirm the candidate is the main plan scale in the title block. Check permitted scales and exceptions under section 1.1.4 and applicable activity provisions.

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Visually confirm the title-block scale bar. Section 1.3.7.2 exempts detail views from the scale-bar requirement.

requirements.summary: Check orientation indicated by north arrows

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Visually confirm the north arrow or arrows indicate main-plan orientation.

requirements.summary: Check the plan type in the heading

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Confirm the heading shows the proposed plan type. Compare the proposal separately with any applicable Table A2 row.

requirements.summary: Check the prescribed hybrid survey heading

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Confirm the main heading states Plan Showing Survey (Hybrid) of and that its purpose matches the application. A text candidate does not establish plan classification; review general and hybrid-specific requirements separately.

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Confirm the main heading states Compiled Plan from Existing Surveys for the Purpose of and matches the application purpose. Section 3.6.1.1 exempts compiled plans from the ordinary heading under 1.2.1.1; a text prefix is not verified plan classification.

requirements.summary: Check the compiled-plan Appendix D declaration and Alberta Land Surveyor signature

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Inspect the Alberta Land Surveyor signature and the Appendix D declaration from the applicable Public Lands Survey Manual. Section 3.6.1.3 replaces the ordinary section 3.1.2 declaration route; verify the current form and its requirements independently.

requirements.summary: Check the heading legal description and plan extents against the application

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Compare the complete legal description and plan extents with the application. Confirm relevant ATS, lot, block, plan and road allowance details.

requirements.summary: Check the full legal municipality name

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Supply municipality_name from the application and verify the full legal name in the heading.

requirements.summary: Check the applicant legal name against the client registry and application

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Supply applicant_name from the application. Confirm the title-block name against both the form and the client registry.

requirements.summary: Check legend explanations and symbol legibility

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Compare the symbols and abbreviations used on the plan with the legend and inspect legibility at the intended plotting scale.

requirements.summary: Check the geo-referenced point and supporting information

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Inspect the plotted symbol and information against the applicable Geo-Referencing Guide.

requirements.summary: Check cadastral fabric and land labels

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Compare the plan with the cadastral source. Review full affected quarters, road allowance and section labels, plus LSD or unsurveyed-territory labels where applicable.

requirements.summary: Check nearby and crossing dispositions and titles

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Compare against the Surface Public Lands Standing Search. Review the listed interests within 250 m adjacent to and through the proposed activity.

requirements.summary: Check nearby hydrography, flow and names

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Check hydrography within 100 m adjacent to and through the proposed activity against relevant source evidence. Confirm flow arrows, applicable names and relevant unmapped features.

requirements.summary: Check the proposed activity outline and extent

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Review outline weight and clarity, road allowance treatment, permitted geometry and bank evidence where applicable. Compare with CAD and land evidence where supplied.

requirements.summary: Check that the total activity area is shown in hectares

citation.publication_title: Content Requirements for Survey Plans and Sketches for Dispositions on Crown Lands

requirements.review_instruction: Confirm the candidate covers the entire activity. Use the separate survey-area comparison to check a reviewer-selected label against supplied survey coordinates.
